newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $3 billion for next week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $3 billion for next week.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for next week are expected to total $3 billion in 96 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $979 million in 50 sales. The largest is a $250 million Illinois deal on Thursday.
Negotiated sales total $2.1 billion in 46 offerings. The largest is a $264 million Harris County Health Facilities Developemental Authority, Texas, issue through Smith Barney Inc.
A total of $428 million of deals are on Reuter's day-to-day calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds next week depending on market conditions.
